tagline: Pioneering neurological and rare disease treatments with FDA-approved therapies
hero_kpi_rationale: Net product sales (NUPLAZID and DAYBUE) total $1,071.5 million in 2025, demonstrating significant growth compared to $957.8 million in 2024 (+12% YoY). This is the key KPI reflecting the commercial success of two core franchises (neurology and rare diseases).

kpis.description: Combined net sales of the two main commercial products (NUPLAZID for neurological syndrome and DAYBUE for Rett syndrome)

kpis.name: R&D Investments
kpis.description: R&D investments to develop new drugs and clinical candidates

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.description: Investments to develop new capabilities and infrastructure

risks.title: Risk of non-compliance with data protection and privacy laws
risks.score_rationale: The risk is explicitly stated with strong language (stringent and evolving laws). The company and its third-party partners must meet strict obligations. Non-compliance could lead to regulatory investigations, litigation, and substantial fines.

risks.title: Risk of cyberattack compromising IT systems or data
risks.score_rationale: The text describes severe consequences (adverse consequences, interruptions to operations or clinical trials, reputational harm, litigation). The board of directors and audit committee provide active oversight. This represents a direct threat to operational continuity.

risks.title: Patent infringement litigation for NUPLAZID
risks.score_rationale: Multiple and active litigations mentioned (MSN, Aurobindo, Zydus) with appeals pending at the Federal Circuit. NUPLAZID is a key commercial product generating a significant portion of revenue. The uncertain outcome could affect the product's patent protection.

risks.title: Securities class action litigation
risks.score_rationale: Action classified with discovery completed and pre-trial procedures ongoing. High risk of monetary damages or governance reforms required.

risks.title: Shareholder derivative lawsuits
risks.score_rationale: Derivative action ongoing but stayed. Preliminary agreement on $1.5M in attorney fees. Less impactful than other litigations but reflects governance risks.

risks.title: Reliance on third parties for cybersecurity and compliance
risks.score_rationale: The risk is explicit in the source: third-party partners must meet the same obligations as the company. Breaches at partner level directly impact ACAD from regulatory and operational standpoints.

ai_positioning.summary: ACAD does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in the business, MD&A, or risk sections of the 10-K report reviewed. The focus remains on traditional drug development and commercialization.
